name: Triptych Music Video Data
description: Finds every song's official music video ahead of time (a 30-second HD preview from Apple Music) for Triptych's Now Playing. Adds an Apple Music Video ID to songs, editable in Edit Metadata. Only links are stored; videos stream from Apple.
overview: Music videos for Triptych's Now Playing

versions.changelog: First version: finds each song's music video (Apple Music preview) for Triptych 2.6.0.
